findings.body: Seen arrays only grow, and session.end never removes their per-session keys. Each new session also copies the board's historical run-end ids (src/forge/board.py:289–300). Claude's [pinned store contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-code/684800b206824dfd0cc8a876e8604b20f72c3617/mods/types/claude-code.d.ts) rejects writes exceeding 4 MiB across the entire store. Once accumulated session history reaches that limit, this write fails after a successful submission; the catch leaves the batch pending and its ids unacknowledged, so subsequent refreshes repeatedly submit it. Baseline writes also fail for new sessions. Retire obsolete session history or otherwise bound storage while preserving occurrence deduplication.
findings.title: Bound persisted seen history before Claude's store limit

findings.body: The previous test-routing gap remains open. forge.toml:6 and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58 run pytest; tests/test_mod_plugin.py:45–57 typecheck the native tests without executing their assertions. The packaged test now exercises the initialization repair, but failed-submit retries, worker/headless gating and session resets still rely on native tests absent from the automated suite. SHIP owns the plugin CI job (plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284), so that task must route these tests into CI.
findings.title: Later: SHIP must run the native event tests in CI
